title: Merged changes sit unreleased for most of a day because releases fail at the helper step
whatHappens: Two release attempts in a row fail at the helper step for different causes, so every change merged after the last good release waits for the next nightly.

fixes.text: Release main now that both helper fixes have merged (morning card item 1); needs owner yes
Smoke the built helper package before publish; slow npm listing only warns

observations.text: 31 Oct-1 Nov: 40 merges, 36 not live. 03:07 UTC release hung in the helper smoke test (fix 06:05 UTC). 07:00 UTC release failed the Linux helper build on a new Rust (fix 13:45 UTC). Server, web and phone-update steps passed.

Release issues 3203, 3208, 3210, 3216, 3217: helper step fails on npm listing wait, Rust toolchain and native runtime compare. Helper 0.1.132 published but npm listed it 17 minutes late. Fix in flight (helper-smoke-tarball corner).

Helper fixes held: 01:57 and 08:50 ET releases delivered server, web, helper and phone updates. New cause: the final release step fails on missing release metadata, so no release record is written and client notices are skipped (5 attempts since v0.1.127). Morning card item 2.
